answer: Every identity starts at the nadir of a stake canyon with a $10 bond. Each ledge doubles the lock ($10 to $320) and needs one verified task in 48 hours. Six ledges to the rim: established. A miss or failed audit drops the climber two ledges and burns 25% of the bond. One yarrow grace per ascent: a 24-hour penalty-free pause — real emergencies survive, bots can't chain pauses. Forging 1,000 fakes locks $630,000 across 6,000 tasks: about $700,000 and weeks of compute per wave. Like climbing out of a canyon, each ledge costs more, and one slip sends you tumbling down.
